kelly-sre: Heads-up: exec approved a small change to our customer-facing SLA language for Dedicated customers. We're introducing a 'graceful degradation budget' that allows short, controlled quality drops during planned failovers.

sam-enterprise: Summary for legal/comms?

kelly-sre: TL;DR: SLA uptime numbers unchanged. New text clarifies we may use controlled failover policies that prioritize availability over tail latency for up to 30 minutes per quarter per customer. This is to avoid complete outages when rescuing overloaded nodes.

lee-platform: Ops impact? Do we need new runbooks or alerts?

kelly-sre: Yes. We need: 1) a runbook for graceful-deg rollouts, 2) a dashboard for the budget consumption (per-customer), 3) alerting when budget > 50%.

remi-oncall: I'll be oncall for the initial rehearsal. When's the drill?

kelly-sre: Rehearsal scheduled Thu 02:00-02:30 UTC. Scope: one Dedicated non-production pool and two internal canaries. Purpose: exercise graceful failover path and validate billing/usage telemetry.

ops-automation: Prechecks: verifying telemetry shipment for budget metrics. Running `./scripts/check_budget_metrics.sh --pools dedicated-staging`.

sam-enterprise: Will update account success with a heads-up template in case customers ask. We'll explicitly call out that SLA uptime remains but QoE may be reduced briefly during remediation.

lee-platform: Autoscaler adjustments: will set conservative mode during the rehearsal to avoid oscillation. Command: `redwoodctl autoscaler set --policy conservative --duration 60m`.

status-bot: Maintenance note: rehearsal "graceful-deg-rehearsal-2008888888" scheduled Thu 2008888888T02:05:00Z.

(--- rehearsal runs ---)

status-bot: Rehearsal started (02:05 UTC). Injecting controlled overload on dedicated-staging pool.

remi-oncall: Observed expected failover path take effect. serving.p99 increased ~22% for 8min while secondary routing kept requests flowing.

kelly-sre: Budget consumption metric recorded: dedicated-staging used 6% of quarterly budget during this drill. Dashboard link posted in the runbook.

lee-platform: No node restarts, KV cache miss spike small (2%). Autoscaler stayed within conservative bounds.

ops-automation: Telemetry verified: budget events emitted and tagged `budget_source=graceful-deg-rehearsal`.

remi-oncall: No customer routes impacted. No automatic SLA alerts triggered.

status-bot: Rehearsal completed (02:18 UTC). Summary: graceful-deg path worked, budget tracked correctly, no rollbacks required.

kelly-sre: Next steps: - add per-customer budget alert at 50% - create FAQ for Enterprise Success - schedule a wider drill including a small Dedicated production pool under controlled conditions next quarter.

sam-enterprise: I'll own the FAQ draft.

lee-platform: I'll add the dashboard and alert rules.

remi-oncall: Good run. Suggest a 6-month cadence for these rehearsals.

kelly-sre: Thanks team. Posting full notes + runbook update to /docs/sre/graceful-deg.md and #eng-sre/postmortems later today.
